facts.fact: The Data Landscapers factsheet lists three in-service cables with a landing at Lagos, Nigeria: Equiano (RFS 2023), SAT-3/WASC (RFS 2001) and MainOne (RFS 2010); three routes, one station town.
Equiano, owned by Google, is in service with a landing at Lagos, Nigeria, ready for service in 2023, per the Data Landscapers factsheet.
SAT-3/WASC, a 36-operator consortium cable, is in service with a landing at Lagos, Nigeria, ready for service in 2001, per the Data Landscapers factsheet.
MainOne, owned by Equinix, is in service from Lagos, Nigeria (to Accra and Seixal), ready for service in July 2010, per the Data Landscapers factsheet.
The factsheet marks MainOne (Lagos landing) open access and says it triggered an ~80% wholesale price crash in Nigeria; the factsheet is AI-compiled by its own admission.

note: WACS, ACE and 2Africa do not name Nigeria among their landings in this document, so no fact; Equiano and SAT-3 'no' open-access flags are not statements that others cannot buy capacity.
